'''2024 Charity Joe Horbey LS RST''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Horbey]] at the [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Joe Horbey]]
* '''Event:''' [[2024 Online Retro Event for Charity]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Classic (no v-cards)|Classic No-V]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]] · [[The Signal]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:2024-retro-24Retro Horbey LS RST.txt|Download]]
